name: Sunday Social Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, wheels down 6:00 am, from the Panera Bread on Germann Rd. The Meetup post lists a 6:00 start every week from Aug 9 through Oct 4, 2026.
pace: "Can be fast, can be slow" in the host's words
visitor_notes: The ride is posted on the group's Meetup page; RSVP there. The host's only promise on pace is that nobody gets dropped. Bike type isn't stated, so ask on the Meetup event if you're unsure. The group also holds a monthly happy hour.
description: A weekly Sunday-morning social ride out of a Panera on Germann Road in southeast Chandler. The host's one line on pace: it can be fast, it can be slow, and there is a no-drop promise. Run through the Southeast Chandler Cycling Meetup group, which has about 1,600 members.
evidence: The group's Meetup calendar lists this ride every Sunday from Aug 9 to Sep 27, 2026 and the next one for Sun Oct 4, 2026 at 6:00 am (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: Meetup posts one Sunday at a time. The title has carried 'new start time 6:00' since at least August, so watch for a winter time change.

name: Taco Tuesday Ride (Wheel Suckers)
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:30 pm start, from Fiesta Mexicana on Alma School Rd. The Sept 29, 2026 Meetup post says 'new start time, route and location'. Wheel Suckers' own site still shows 6:00 pm from Nando's Mexican Cafe on Germann Rd, so confirm before you go.

start_location.name: Fiesta Mexicana Restaurant
start_location.address: 4949 S Alma School Rd, Chandler, AZ 85248

pace: A group 20+ mph, B group 18+ mph, C group 16+ mph

host.name: Wheel Suckers Cycling with Global Bikes & E-Bikes

visitor_notes: Lights are required, plus helmet and repair supplies. The host runs a pre-ride huddle on safety and the route. Food and drinks follow at the start restaurant. Wheel Suckers' site lists a ride waiver. The Meetup post calls it a no-drop road ride but also lists an A group; the Wheel Suckers site says the A group is a drop ride and the C group is no-drop.
description: A Tuesday-evening road ride of about 21 miles that ends with tacos and drinks. Wheel Suckers and Global Bikes run it together in A, B and C groups, with a shorter C route of 18.5 miles. It's a regular on the Wheel Suckers calendar and the Global Bikes Meetup.
evidence: The Global Bikes Meetup lists the Taco Tuesday Ride for Tue Sept 29, 2026 at 6:30 pm with a 'new start time, route and location' note and a C route revised 5/2/2026; wheelsuckers.org lists it as 'Every Tuesday' (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: No feed_url on purpose. The group's Meetup feed (https://www.meetup.com/global-bikes-meetup/events/ical/) did not carry this ride on Sept 30: the Sept 29 ride had passed and the Oct 6 date was not yet posted (Global Bikes posts about a week ahead). Re-check the events page. The Meetup time and start (6:30 pm, Fiesta Mexicana) differ from wheelsuckers.org (6:00 pm, Nando's); the Meetup post is the dated one.

name: B.E.S.T. Beginner to Expert Saturday Training
schedule: Five Saturdays: Oct 24, Oct 31, Nov 7, Nov 14 and Nov 21, 2026. Start times vary by week (7:30, 7:30, 7:00, 7:15, 6:15 am). A free orientation is Wed Oct 21 at 6:00 pm. You can join the program at any time.
pace: Beginner pace; distance builds from 10-15 miles in week one to 30 by the end
visitor_notes: Free, including the orientation. Bring a road bike or a hybrid with narrow tires, and a helmet. The host says someone will stay with you if you fall behind. Global Bikes has a ride waiver. The program's Strava club is invite-only. The event text still mentions an April orientation date, so the program seems to run more than once a year.
description: A free five-week program for new road cyclists, from the Global Bikes store in north Chandler. It starts with an evening orientation, then a Saturday ride each week that builds from 10 miles to 30. The shop says it also welcomes people coming back to cycling after a break.
evidence: The Global Bikes Meetup lists the orientation for Wed Oct 21, 2026 and the five Saturday rides from Oct 24 to Nov 21, 2026 (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: A dated series, not a weekly ride. On Sept 30 the group's feed carried the Oct 21 orientation but not yet the five Saturdays. Re-check in November for the next session's dates.

name: Wednesday Night Roll: No Drop
schedule: Every Wednesday, 7:00 pm, listed through Oct 28, 2026. Meet at the flagpole parking and arrive 10 minutes early.

start_location.name: San Tan Mountain Regional Park, flagpole parking
start_location.address: 6533 W Phillips Rd, Queen Creek, AZ

pace: Rolling trails with some technical spots, pitched at a newer rider up to a confident intermediate
founded_note: Santan Shredders' website says it was founded in 2013.
visitor_notes: Bring bright lights (the host says 700+ lumens), a helmet, snacks and water. A mountain bike or gravel bike works. Join the Meetup group and RSVP on the event. Park entry (as listed Sept 2026): a Maricopa County annual pass, $10 per vehicle, or $5 on foot or by bike.
description: A mid-week night ride on the trails at San Tan Mountain Regional Park, run as a no-drop ride by Santan Shredders. The host describes meandering trails with just-right climbs, a few technical spots and nobody left behind on a first night ride. Mountain bikes and gravel bikes both work.
evidence: Santan Shredders' Meetup lists a weekly series, 'Every week on Wednesday until October 28, 2026', with dates for Sept 30 and Oct 7, 14, 21 and 28 at 7:00 pm (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: The series ends Oct 28. Watch for the next series or a winter time.

name: Shift into the Weekend MTB Ride
schedule: Third Saturday of the month. Start time slides with the season: 6:00 am on Sept 19, 7:00 am on Oct 17 and Nov 21, 8:00 am on Dec 19, 2026. Check in 10 minutes early.

start_location.name: San Tan Mountain Regional Park
start_location.address: 6533 W Phillips Rd, Queen Creek, AZ

pace: Solid pace with regroups; gravel crunch and dirt flow
founded_note: Santan Shredders' website says it was founded in 2013.
visitor_notes: Join the Meetup group, request to join, then RSVP. Bring water, snacks, a helmet and a spare tube. Park entry (as listed Sept 2026): a Maricopa County annual pass, $10 per vehicle, or $5 on foot or by bike. Some months the group also lists an edition at Usery Mountain Regional Park, so read the event's location.
description: A monthly Saturday-morning mountain or gravel ride at San Tan Mountain Regional Park. The host calls it no-drop, with regroups often and a mix of gravel and dirt. Santan Shredders runs it on the third Saturday of each month.
evidence: Santan Shredders' Meetup lists the ride for Sat Oct 17, Nov 21 and Dec 19, 2026, and Sept 19, 2026 as the latest past date (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: Dates are posted months ahead. Check that the third-Saturday pattern holds into 2027.

name: The Sunday Kickoff
schedule: Every Sunday. Start place and time are posted by Thursday each week on PMBC's RideWithGPS calendar. Usual start by month: Jan-Feb 9:00 am, Mar 8:00, Apr 7:30, May 7:00, Jun-Aug 6:30, Sep 7:00, Oct 7:30, Nov 8:00, Dec 8:30. Breakfast usually follows.

start_location.name: Varies each week around the East Valley. The Sept 27, 2026 start was the Panera Bread at the SE corner of Guadalupe and McClintock.
start_location.address: Panera Bread, SE corner of Guadalupe Rd and McClintock Dr, Tempe, AZ

visitor_notes: Visitors are always welcome. A helmet is required and earphones are not allowed. Anyone much faster or slower than the group should plan to handle their own navigation. Look up the week's start on the RideWithGPS calendar; RSVP is optional. Contact: rideleaders@pmbcaz.org (put the ride name in the subject).
description: PMBC's Sunday social road ride around the East Valley, 25 to 30 miles at 15 to 17 mph, with breakfast after. The start moves from week to week and is posted by Thursday. The club says visitors are always welcome.
evidence: PMBC's RideWithGPS calendar lists Sunday Kickoff for Sept 6, 13, 20 and 27, 2026; the Sept 27 event page shows a 7:00 am start at Panera Bread, SE corner Guadalupe / McClintock (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club calendar shows the next week's start place and time by Thursday. The description page's monthly start-time table matched the September events.

name: Wednesday No-Drop
schedule: Every Wednesday. Start place varies around the Southeast Valley and is posted on PMBC's RideWithGPS calendar. Usual start by month: Jan 8:30 am, Feb-Mar 8:00, Apr 7:30, May 7:00, Jun-Aug 6:30, Sep 7:00, Oct 7:30, Nov 8:00, Dec 8:30. Breakfast or brunch follows.

start_location.name: Varies each week around the Southeast Valley; see the RideWithGPS calendar

pace: About 12 mph with beginners, with short runs up to 20 mph
visitor_notes: Visitors are always welcome. A helmet is required and earphones are not allowed. Check the RideWithGPS calendar for the week's start. Contact: rideleaders@pmbcaz.org (put 'Wednesday No-Drop' in the subject).
description: A weekday-morning no-drop road ride in the Southeast Valley, run by PMBC. Distance and pace follow whoever turns up, usually 20 to 32 miles at about 12 mph, with a stop for breakfast after. It moves its start around, so the calendar is the thing to check.
evidence: PMBC's RideWithGPS calendar lists No Drop Wednesday for Sept 9, 16 and 23, 2026; the Sept 23 event page shows a 7:00 am start (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: The event pages give coordinates but no street address for the start. The next date was not yet posted on Sept 30.
